title: ReviewOutput
description: Structured output from a review council run

evidence_quality.description: Evidence quality: strong=all claims verified, adequate=2+ sources, weak=insufficient

weighted_score.description: Weighted quality score incorporating severity and evidence quality of findings

findings.description: All review findings from all perspectives, deduplicated and sorted

file.description: File path where the finding applies

line.description: Line number (null if applies to whole file)

why_it_matters.description: Concrete failure mode or impact — not a vague concern

autofix_class.description: safe_auto=apply automatically, gated_auto=needs approval, manual=design decision, advisory=informational

requires_verification.description: Whether the fix needs explicit verification before merge

evidence_quality.description: Evidence quality for this finding (weak findings suppressed except P0)

evidence.description: Code-grounded references supporting this finding (at least 1 required)

pre_existing.description: Whether this issue existed before the current changes (report but don't affect verdict)

perspectives_run.description: Which review perspectives were executed (e.g. security, architecture, performance)

dedup_merges.description: Number of duplicate findings merged during the merge pipeline

suppressed_below_threshold.description: Number of findings suppressed due to weak evidence_quality threshold
